clues.text: Jesus said that if His miracles in Chorazin and Bethsaida had been done here, it would have repented in sackcloth.
Jesus went to this region, where a Syrophoenician woman begged Him to drive a demon from her daughter.
Paul's ship unloaded cargo at this port, and disciples there urged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
Ezekiel was told to warn its proud ruler, who claimed to be a god but was only a man.
Ezekiel said Nebuchadnezzar's army labored against this city until heads were bald, yet earned no wages from it.
Isaiah foretold that this city of merchants would be forgotten for seventy years, then restored by the LORD.
Nehemiah found men from this city in Jerusalem selling fish and goods to Judah on the Sabbath.
